controller_buffer_notes: the trace is collected from a fresh, reset environment whose construction, seed and ordered operations are recorded in `recipe`
the controller/observable buffers therefore start from the post-reset state and are reproduced by re-running the same recipe
this does not transfer to the original external recording: its own buffers are not stored in the npz (see source_fidelity)
name: n04ext_libero_variant_00

ordered_operations: apply warmstart policy at build time when warmstart_mode=disabled_by_flag
per step t: apply warmstart policy; env.step(issued_command[t]); read post_state[t]

recomputability.rule: bit-exact recomputation of 'executed action -> state transition' requires all of: (1) pre_state, post_state and issued_command on every step; (2) a controlled solver warm-start: warmstart_mode in {disabled_by_flag, zeroed_each_step} or warmstart_mode=saved_before_step together with the recorded qacc_warmstart_before array; (3) an explicit controller/observable buffer policy: recorded_initial_conditions (the recipe fixes them from a fresh, reset environment) or declared_not_recomputable; (4) the ordered replay recipe; and (5) a passing verification replay (verification.bit_exact == true). Missing any of (1)-(4) leaves only phase-level evidence.

verification.method: re-run the recorded recipe in a fresh environment and re-apply the recorded warm-start policy, then compare with the collected post_state

source_fidelity.basis: S0 action-phase verification: k=+1 median 1.6e-4..7.1e-4 and 70-300x better than the wrong lags, but bit-exact replay of the external recording is not achievable because it does not store qacc_warmstart or the controller buffers

step_field_semantics.issued_command: command actually passed to the simulator at this step (float32)
step_field_semantics.post_state: flattened simulator state after the step (float64)
step_field_semantics.pre_state: flattened simulator state before the step, [time, qpos, qvel] (float64)
step_field_semantics.step_index: 0-based index of the collected step inside this trace

warmstart_semantics: write zeros into qacc_warmstart before every step (cold start)
